system.description: (Specification Required) The person knows all about a culture’s laws and legal systems, customs, gestures, taboos, food habits, rules of conduct, typical dress, and housing, as well as their common attributes, personalities, and appearances. The person can add +2 to their Skill Value per level when trying to learn about a people’s customs. The specialty focuses on a single culture: Stormlanders, Mittlanders, Viranns, Wildfolks, Dwarves, or Elves.
system.summary: Knows everything about a given culture: its laws, customs, taboos, foodways, codes of conduct and typical appearance.
